prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a serpent-tailed woman: a human upper body with pale sage-green skin, bronze armlets and a bronze breastband, a clear pale face with two large bright yellow eyes and a dark mouth, a head of about eight thick dark emerald snakes for hair with small heads, clearly darker than the face, two arms, no legs: below the waist a long dark green snake tail with a pale yellow belly coiled on the ground; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, the snake hair well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: her pale sage-green face with two large bright yellow eyes under the dark snake hair is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, leaning forward over the coils toward the heroes, both clawed hands reaching out with the elbows bent, the snake hair lashing forward, the hands well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back over the coils, the head tilted back with the pale face and yellow eyes still visible, the snake hair writhing, the arms flung up, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Lean and twist the upper body along a strong diagonal above the coils, extend the arms and weapons far from the body, tighten or loosen the coils, and let the tail tip lash. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, a humanoid upper body on a serpent tail, no legs: coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, legs, a weapon, a bow, a shield, a crown, wings, a fish tail, stone colour, a hidden face.
